entries.document: QSC WideLine-8 Series Loudspeaker System User Manual, TD-000237-00 rev D (4 chunks)
entries.evidence: WL3082: "The WL3082 input connectors are a pair of Neutrik NL8's wired in parallel ... The WL3082 loudspeaker is not equipped with a crossover network. All signal processing must be done before connecting audio power to the loudspeaker." The manual documents only NL8/NL4 audio-power inputs, per-band nominal impedance and continuous power capacity; it lists no mains connection, no amplifier output rating and no gain/level control. WL212-sw: "The WL212-sw is equipped with two NL8 connectors with pins 1+ and 1- connected to the transducers", and "Its two ceramic magnet, 4" voice coil, 12" transducers provide 1100 watt continuous power handling capability." The subwoofer section never uses the words passive, active, powered or built-in amplification.

fieldResults.note: The exact-model QSC manual states that "audio power" is connected to the loudspeaker and that it has no crossover network or internal processing; the only inputs are NL8 audio-power connectors. This is an explicit statement of the external-amplification signal path, so the stored passive value is retained and re-sourced from the specification sheet to the manual.

Neither the specification sheet nor the user manual states passive/active or built-in amplification for the WL212-sw; the manual only describes the NL8/NL4 wiring to the transducers and a 1100 W continuous power-handling capability. Under the standing explicit-evidence rule the Round 22 manufacturer-verified promotion is retracted and the field returns to unknown.
